definition: A research approach studying whether a stronger AI model can be effectively supervised and aligned using labels or feedback generated by a weaker model or weaker human oversight.
details: Weak-to-strong generalization research is motivated by the anticipated future challenge of humans needing to oversee AI systems that may exceed human capability in many domains, testing whether alignment techniques still work under this asymmetry.

citation.title: Weak-to-Strong Generalization: Eliciting Strong Capabilities With Weak Supervision
